company.name: Varos
company.shortDescription: Extract critical business intelligence through employee interviews conducted by AI Agents
company.description:
Varos delivers the work of business analysts 10x faster, better, and cheaper using AI agents built for discovery.

Most organizations rely on consultants, analysts, and countless meetings just to uncover knowledge their teams already have. Varos solves this by deploying AI agents that act as Senior Business Analysts—they talk to your teams through brief voice or text interviews, capture institutional knowledge, and analyze findings to deliver actionable insights.

The information gathered is transformed into a secure, private knowledge base that organizations can use to assess current operations, capture business requirements, and share know-how across teams.

In short, Varos helps companies uncover, understand, and use their own knowledge faster and more effectively

insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $3,769,899 to $24,546,131, a 6.51x increase.

caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.
